notes: Khai'ro. His movement and normals are from the owner's sheets and brief (Nov 26): frame data, holds, guards and cancels are the owner's; damage, stun, pushback, every box and the step speeds are first guesses (the engine test character's numbers per strength) to be tuned in the editor. Two specials so far: 236 Bracelet Slam (a lobbed projectile, all first guesses) and 214 Low Blade (a low wave along the floor; its input and every number are first guesses, the owner gave art only). No throws art, hit reactions or blocks are drawn yet; the throw (6H) is still the test character's. Sheets are cut by scripts/khairo-sheets.mjs (5M is cleaned first by scripts/khairo-clean.mjs).
